pdf.title: Google Store - Asian Display Assembly Quality Audit Report (Lot DISP-P11-904)

sections.heading: 1. Executive Summary & Audit Scope
sections.content: This audit covers factory acceptance testing for 50,000 Super Actua OLED display assemblies manufactured for Google Pixel 11 Pro (SKU-PX11P-256-OBS) at the Tainan assembly plant between August 1 and August 25, 2026. Shipments were consigned to European Central Distribution (Tilburg, Netherlands).

sections.heading: 2. High-Frequency Micro-Flicker Anomaly & Calibration Variance
sections.content: During secondary quality inspection at the factory gate, display sub-lot DISP-P11-904 exhibited an 8.4% variance in pulse-width modulation (PWM) frequency stability below 30% display brightness. While factory automated test equipment (ATE) initially logged a 1.2% minor variance, European repair center (B2X Frankfurt) intake records report a verified failure rate of 9.6% on European customer preorders.

sections.heading: 3. Cross-Source Reconciliation & Recommended Actions
sections.content:
1. Quarantine remaining factory inventory of display lot DISP-P11-904.
2. Reconcile internal RMA tickets (RMA-2026-0401 through RMA-2026-0410) against factory calibration serial logs.
3. Accelerate firmware patch release OT-P11-26.2 to adjust low-light PWM duty cycle.
4. Proactively grant €50 Google Store promotional credits to affected Tier-1 preorder customers.
